definitions_and_hypotheses_checked: SmoothingBridgeConclusion stores a separate model topology, charted space, smooth manifold instance, compactness, countability, connectedness, and the specific homeomorphism from M.

HasOneSimplyConnectedEnd quantifies over every compact C, chooses a larger compact D with connected complement, and contracts loops outside D while avoiding C; it is not simple connectedness of one complement.

HasWallCompactCore requires a connected PL domain with compact frontier, the one-end predicate, and a compact A subset R; it returns compact K, one chartwise PL sphere S, exact frontier equations, and relative protection.

HasHamiltonChartHandleStraightening quantifies over every open partial homeomorphism, every open neighborhood of the cylinder frontier, and every locally piecewise-affine overlap, with a supported ambient homotopy.
The index-three handle is supplied by Alexander region balls; lower indices use Wall, generalized Dehn, protected prime replacement, and relative rigidity.
Finite geometric triangulation hypotheses include purity, connected edge links, two-point triangle links, and an affine injective Brouwer star at each vertex.

The original geometric triangulation may have dependent vertices; exists_independent_euclidean_realization constructs an independent realization on the same labelled complex with a carrier left inverse.
Cairns smoothing is applied after independent re-realization and then pulled back along the same carrier homeomorphism.
M77 transports simple connectedness to the stored model and separately packages the full M02 ClosedSimplyConnectedThreeManifoldConclusion.
M78 consumes the smooth endpoint on that model and composes its diffeomorphism with the stored M76 homeomorphism; M79 universally quantifies this composition.

substantive_proof_mechanisms.mechanism: Protected compression complexity decreases under essential disk cuts; terminal finite spherical frontiers are filled and reduced by a strict sphere-count induction while preserving the old frontier and protected interior.
Innermost intersection cuts decrease the double-curve/marked-arc termination measure; finite collar residual triangulations retain the prescribed boundary data.

Relative compressions produce an irreducible replacement chart family with both old-to-new and new-to-old chartwise-PL identity maps on a protected neighborhood; the three period cases then feed relative torus rigidity and bounded lifts.
A finite Hamilton face order adds one simplex at a time; supported handle corrections are extended by identity and composed, preserving the protected set and local PL overlap property.
Basis vectors indexed by the finite vertex subtype yield affine face maps with a linear carrier left inverse, then finite purity/link/Brouwer-star checks invoke the analytic atlas construction.

Install the stored model instances, transport simple connectedness through the inverse homeomorphism, apply M02 and smooth Poincare on that model, and compose the resulting homeomorphism with the same stored map.

findings.finding: The handle predicate was described as affine on the unit ball and used the wrong local-PL domain; the prose now states finite piecewise-affinity of e composed with A on the closed unit ball and local piecewise-affinity of e on e.source intersected with N.

The protected-prime paragraph incorrectly claimed a product-model homotopy equivalence; it now states the exact irreducible chart-family and two-direction chartwise-PL identity package exported by HasHamiltonProtectedIrreducibleReplacement.
The Cairns bridge now follows the implemented smooth leaf-field, transversality, and projection-coordinate identities rather than claiming literal projection agreement on shared faces.
HamiltonAlexanderConsequences and ZeroChargeRegionBalls provide both complementary finite-PL ball certificates and the chart-image identification for the index-three case.

The current bridge preserves the labelled carrier through the embedded-image homeomorphism; the basis constr map supplies the left-inverse argument used to establish injectivity before the Cairns bridge.
Topology.lean transports simple connectedness through the inverse of the stored model homeomorphism, while M78 consumes that field and composes the smooth endpoint with the same selected map.
